questions.question: In a tank, solutions A, B and C are mixed in the ratio 5:3:2 respectively. 10 liters of this mixture is taken out. After this, 5 liters of solution A and 3 liters of solution C are added to the tank. If after these operations the amount of solution A becomes 25 liters more than the amount of solution B, then what was the total amount of mixture initially present in the tank (in liters)?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Let the tank hold 10x at 5 : 3 : 2. The 10 L 
removed takes 5, 3 and 2. 
A = 5x − 5        B = 3x − 3        C = 2x − 2 
 Step 2   Now 5 L of A and 3 L of C go back. 
A = 5x        B = 3x − 3        C = 2x + 1 
 Step 3   A exceeds B by 25 L. 
5x − (3x − 3) = 25   ⇒  2x = 22   ⇒  x = 11 
 Step 4   The tank. 
10x = 110 L 
Total = 10k. Removing 10 L takes A : B : C = 5 : 3 
: 2 (one whole set), then + 5 L A and + 3 L C: 
𝐴 =  5𝑘,   𝐵 =  3𝑘 − 3,   𝐶 =  2𝑘 +  1 
5𝑘−(3𝑘−3) = 25 →𝑘= 11 
𝑡𝑜𝑡𝑎𝑙 =  10𝑘 =  110 𝐿

questions.question: The ratio of principal and amount for one year is 5 : 6. Find the rate of simple interest.
questions.solution:
Step 1   P : A = 5 : 6, so the interest is the gap. 
I = A − P = 6 − 5 = 1 part,  on a principal of 5 parts 
 Step 2   One year, so R is just I/P as a percentage. 
R = (1/5) × 100 = 20%

questions.question: A sum of ₹800 becomes ₹1040 at simple interest in 3 years. If the interest rate is increased by 3%, then find the amount. ₹800
questions.solution:
Step 1   Find the original rate from the given 
amount. 
SI = 1040 − 800 = ₹240 over 3 yr   ∴  r = 240 × 
100 / (800 × 3) = 10% 
 Step 2   The rate rises by 3%, so only that 3% is 
new. 
extra = 800 × 3 × 3 / 100 = ₹72 
 Step 3   Add it to the amount already worked out. 
New amount = 1040 + 72 = ₹1,112

questions.question: The interest on a certain deposit at 4.5% p.a is ₹135 in one year. How much additional interest in one year be on the same deposit at 5% per annum?
questions.solution:
Step 1   Compare the two rates. 
4.5% → 5% is an increase of 0.5%,  and 4.5 ÷ 0.5 
= 9 
 Step 2   Scale the interest by the same factor. 
extra interest = 135 ÷ 9 = ₹15
